items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Those were our stars that we’d hitched our wagons to. ... Parker and Gillespie, you know, Monk, J. J. Johnson and others

ctx.x: And I wondered, and this is a real digression, is there some connection? I mean do you feel a connection with Coltrane? Does the 23rd -- does that day -- does that mean something to you?
Definitely. I feel a connection -- there’s a fact that in although we’re two years apart, he having been born in 1926. Before he joined -- was it with Monk first or Miles?
I think it was Miles first. I think it was Miles, Monk, Miles.
